name: Foma Fomapan 100 Classic
notes: Foma datasheet 'FOMAPAN 100 Classic', 2 pages, vector (page 1: data and plots; page 2: development time curves). No publication number is printed; the date is the footer code 'FOMA 05/22' on page 2. Speed ISO 100/21 deg (21 deg CSN), panchromatic.

curves: page 1, 'Characteristic curves', exposure Daylight 5500 K, 1/20 s, developer Microphen at 20 C, three curves 1 = 5 min, 2 = 7 min, 3 = 11 min. x axis is 'Log rel. exposure' (relative, no absolute lux-seconds; labelled -3, -2, -1 with the frame edge at 0, calibrated on those grid lines), y is density (0 to 3). Curves are traced from the vector paths; they start at the frame edge (log rel. exposure -3.2) and stop at about -0.35 (D 1.95-2.95). Their toe levels differ (fog plus base about 0.16 for 5 min, 0.28 for 7 min, 0.35 for 11 min).

v is the 7 min curve: the sheet lists Microphen stock 5-7 min at 20 C and gives granularity at 'gamma = 0.6'; the page 2 gamma-time plot for Microphen 20 C reaches gamma 0.6 at about 6 to 6.5 min, between the plotted 5 and 7 min curves, and the speed S (ISO) curve passes ISO 100 near 6 min. 7 min is nearest to both and inside the recommended range; the others are v-microphen-5 and v-microphen-11 (11 min is outside the recommended range). The sheet marks no curve as standard.

sensitivity: page 1, 'Relative spectral sensitivity (wedge spectrogram at 2850 K)', a plotted curve (vector) with axis label S-lambda and no numbers or units on the y axis, so it is not known whether it is linear or logarithmic. y here is the fraction of the frame height (0 = bottom of the frame, 1 = top), nothing more; do not read it as log sensitivity without checking. x runs 400-750 nm on grid lines every 50 nm; the curve starts at 400 nm (frame edge) and falls steeply from about 645 nm to the frame bottom at about 667 nm, so the last samples there are approximate.

Grain: RMS 13.5 (Microphen at 20 C, developed to gamma = 0.6, measured at D = 1.0); aperture not stated. Resolving power 110 lines/mm. Schwarzschild effect table, development time table (Microphen stock 5-7 min at 20 C, 2 min at 30 C) on page 1.
